findings.entity: Man's right hand, gold coin, and leftmost cup
findings.description: As the man's right hand lowers the coin toward the cup opening at 00:03, the coin clips through the cup rim at 00:04 and becomes plastered vertically against the outside wall of the cup. findings.entity: Man's left hand, gold coin, and rightmost cup
